internal.qualification: Internal DRAM payloads and internal descriptors plus private raw-flash/NVS persistence across QMP reset and process relaunch; never PSRAM qualification

octal-unsupported.qualification: Explicitly unsupported. Startup failure or UNSUPPORTED is not a passing memory leaf. Runner refuses this mode.

Public esp_psram_is_initialized/esp_psram_get_size and real SSI RDID, read with locked IDF quad command semantics under SDK cache guard
MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM|MALLOC_CAP_8BIT payload allocation and explicit CPU alias checks; descriptors MALLOC_CAP_INTERNAL|MALLOC_CAP_DMA|MALLOC_CAP_8BIT
Three real IN and OUT descriptors, owner writeback, received lengths and successful EOF plus raw GDMA completion
CPU dirty source remains new while GDMA observes previously committed bytes before esp_cache_msync C2M; GDMA observes new bytes after writeback
CPU cached destination remains old while GDMA sees newly written physical bytes before esp_cache_msync M2C; CPU observes new bytes after invalidation
Internal-to-external, external-to-internal and external-to-external transfers at block/burst 16,32,64
A heap-owned payload crosses an ordinary 64KiB MMU page boundary without modifying mappings
Real RX DSCR_ERR for external payload+1 at each supported block alignment

Real TX and RX DSCR_ERR for an MMU-table-verified unmapped alias only after esp_mmu_vaddr_to_paddr returns ESP_ERR_NOT_FOUND; the probe scans the real table and never uses the last DROM entry, which IDF image_process owns as a transient boot-partition map page (MMU_LL_END_DROM_ENTRY_ID)
Actual running-app, NVS and private raw partition discovery; esp_partition_read and esp_flash_read must agree on the app header and high-byte raw payload
esp_flash reads the first flash header at address0; host binds both32-byte headers to the exact built merged image
769-byte asymmetric high-byte pattern written to private mem_raw partition and memory_fixture NVS namespace; nvs_commit then close/reopen phase and full blob readback
Fresh retained writable copy only, cache=writethrough and no snapshot=on; initial phase0->1, actual QMP system_reset phase1->2, orderly process termination/relaunch of the same file phase2->3
All existing internal CPU/GDMA and PSRAM CPU/cache/GDMA acceptance cases execute on each of the three boots; host validates complete consumer results each time

Disk SHA256 and raw/NVS partition hashes recorded before and after each boot and process close; raw bytes must match committed phase, NVS disk changes each phase, app immutable, original merged image unchanged
Host recomputes complete384-byte FNV32 and16-byte prefixes independently from consumer buffer observations

qtest_owner_contract.mmu_remap: Map two aliases to actual SSI physical pages; dirty/writeback/invalidate one alias then remap64KiB entries and prove GDMA/CPU translation and physical data. Restore mappings; do not remap a firmware heap page.
qtest_owner_contract.capacity_end: Map supported last physical page, exercise last valid bytes, then physical8MiB capacity-end/whole-span failure with DSCR_ERR, not fabricated ID/capacity or unmapped suppression.
qtest_owner_contract.reset_persistence: Write actual physical bytes, perform ordinary documented reset, prove backing persistence independently from cache invalidation/reset. Firmware startup PSRAM_MEMTEST may overwrite heap and cannot imply persistence.
qtest_owner_contract.cache_instructions: S3 has XCHAL_DCACHE_SIZE=0 and no dhwb/dhi/dhwbi ISA. Qualify real ROM EXTMEM cache-assist operations, including SyncSize=0 whole-cache behavior, in qtest; do not invent unsupported instructions. Firmware covers ordinary esp_cache_msync C2M/M2C ROM/register paths.

cpu_unmapped_negative.reason: An ordinary IDF CPU read of a proved-unmapped PSRAM alias is fatal; this consumer has no safe documented exception/resume profile. No successful CPU read is fabricated. Existing esp_mmu_vaddr_to_paddr plus real GDMA TX/RX DSCR_ERR remain distinct explicit negative coverage.

flash_persistence_protocol.partitions: partitions.csv: NVS0x9000..0xefff; running factory app0x10000..0x20ffff; private mem_raw0x210000..0x210fff
boots: same writable flash process relaunch phase2->3
flash_persistence_protocol.fresh_requirement: Initial namespace phase and blob both absent, raw payload all0xff; no erase-on-nvs-init-error fallback
flash_persistence_protocol.exclusions: Flash/NVS persistence does not imply PSRAM backing reset retention. The latter remains qtest-owned.

source_build_gate: Commands are source-ready only. Build/run only after parent READY for this exact source map and binary. No verification performed by author.
build_commands: For internal: use build=$ESP32S3_IDF_BUILD_ROOT/memory_native-internal and SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS=$fixture/sdkconfig.defaults only; custom partitions.csv applies to both leaves.
For5.5.5: source ~/.cache/esp32s3vm/idf/idf-5.5.5-b774170ff46c393eeb5e495ea37936038d3f4f4f/activate.sh then use its separate native build root with identical commands.
run_matrix: Run this command for each locked SDK and both internal/psram leaves (adjust build and --mode); no octal passing leaf.
evidence_policy: Fresh retained directory per invocation with scratch writable-flash.bin; each process command, per-process UART/stdout/stderr, per-boot UART, full QMP send/receive/reset transcript, before/after whole-disk and partition SHA256, original unchanged evidence and failure result. Exact locked SDK metadata, project_description and sdkconfig, compiled source hashes, ELF SHA embedded app binding, merged-image built-input binding, QEMU source inventory and executable hash, approved initial source-map hash/pinned preparation inputs and copy-destination hashes. Required .esp32s3vm-memory-inputs/prepared-source.json must bind base/prefix/source-map hash, all immutable input snapshots and prepared target hashes; negative_without_spi1_fix is rejected for this positive runner. Host watchdog never fabricates firmware success. No qtest/provider/guest-state injection.

changelog.change: Added genuine ordinary app/flash-header and private raw-partition/NVS blob consumers, monotonically flash-derived phase across real QMP reset and same-disk relaunch, full memory leaf checks on every boot, immutable original evidence, and approved initial source-map runner binding. Authored only; no build/run claims.

Unmapped-alias probe now selects its page from the actual MMU table (skipping the last DROM entry, IDF's transient boot-partition map page) instead of assuming 0x3dff0000 is unmapped; the earlier assumption failed on ordinary IDF 6.1 startup, which legitimately maps that entry.
